mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) increases risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias, which ondansetron may potentiate through its own dose-dependent QT-prolonging effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain normal potassium and magnesium levels, use lowest effective ondansetron dose, and consider ECG monitoring if concurrent use is necessary.
